remarks:
Welcome to 206 N Park Ave! 
Tucked away in a highly desirable, walker's paradise in North Buffalo, this classic 1920s traditional double presents a phenomenal opportunity. The location of this property puts you steps away from the bustling shopping, dining, and entertainment corridor of Hertel Avenue. Whether you are looking to build long-term rental equity or owner-occupy a spacious duplex while letting a tenant help cover the mortgage, this North Park neighborhood gem delivers.
Lower Unit (1,322 sq. ft.): Spaciously set first-floor living with high-demand functional appeal. 3 bed 2 bath with large kitchen and great front porch.
Upper Unit (1,106 sq. ft.): Bright and inviting layout featuring a large kitchen with 2 beds 1 bath.  It also has access to the full attic space allowing for incredible storage options.
Rare Oversized Lot: Unlike typical city parcels, this property enjoys a massive 50 x 175 lot (over 8,750 sq. ft. / 0.20 acres), offering an expansive backyard perfect for tenant recreation or gardening.
Off-Street Parking: A private driveway leads to a substantial 480 sq. ft. detached garage (built 1973), a highly coveted asset for Buffalo winters. 24 hour notice required, tenant occupied.
